h1: ASVAB Practice Test & Quiz — Instant Answers & Explanations
subhead: Take a free practice quiz or point your phone at any ASVAB-style question for the answer plus a fast explanation — Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, and more, without the guesswork.
metaTitle: ASVAB Practice Test & Quiz: Instant Answers | Cambo
metaDescription: Free ASVAB practice test and quiz questions with instant, explained answers. Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Mechanical Comprehension, and more.
whyItWorks: The ASVAB covers ten different subtests, and your AFQT score depends specifically on four of them — it's easy to spend prep time on the wrong sections. Cambo answers whatever question is in front of you and explains the reasoning, so you can drill the subtests that actually move your score.

sampleQuestions.q: A vehicle travels 240 miles in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
Which word most nearly means the same as 'meticulous'?
sampleQuestions.a: Careful — meticulous means showing great attention to detail and being extremely careful and precise.

sampleQuestions.q: Which organ in the human body is primarily responsible for filtering waste from the blood?
sampleQuestions.a: The kidneys — they filter blood to remove waste products and excess fluid, which are then excreted as urine.

sampleQuestions.q: In a system of pulleys, what is the main advantage of adding more pulleys?
options: It increases the speed at which the load rises
It reduces the total distance the rope must travel
It eliminates friction in the system
It reduces the force needed to lift the load, at the cost of pulling more rope
sampleQuestions.a: It reduces the force needed to lift a load, at the cost of pulling more rope — mechanical advantage trades force for distance.

sampleQuestions.q: A store marks up an item that costs $40 by 25%. What is the selling price?
Which word most nearly means the opposite of 'candid'?
sampleQuestions.a: Evasive — candid means open and honest, so its opposite describes being deliberately vague or indirect.

faqs.a: Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery — a multi-subject test used to determine eligibility for military enlistment and qualification for specific military jobs.

The Armed Forces Qualification Test score, a composite of four ASVAB subtests (Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, and Mathematics Knowledge) that determines basic enlistment eligibility.
It depends on the branch and the job you want — different military occupational specialties require different minimum ASVAB line scores, not just a single overall number.

faqs.q: Is Cambo affiliated with the military or the official ASVAB program?
faqs.a: No. Cambo is an independent study tool, not produced or endorsed by the Department of Defense or any branch of the U.S. military.

faqs.q: How many subtests are on the ASVAB?
faqs.a: Ten, covering general science, arithmetic reasoning, word knowledge, paragraph comprehension, mathematics knowledge, electronics information, auto and shop information, mechanical comprehension, and assembling objects.
Yes, though there are mandatory waiting periods between attempts, and retake policies are set by the official ASVAB testing program.
